title: Semilinear wave equations in homothetic hyperboloidal coordinates and tail decay
summary: Late-time wave tails decay at different rates along future null infinity and along timelike worldlines at finite radius. A compactified numerical evolution must represent both the slower decay at null infinity and the faster interior decay, producing an increasingly sharp transition between the two regimes. We address this difficulty for semilinear wave equations in Minkowski spacetime using homothetic hyperboloidal coordinates adapted to the scaling structure of the tail. In these coordinates, the tail approaches a smooth radial profile with the same decay rate at every compactified radius.…
